object.attr: as implemented: the manifest's name marks the folder as a document, so no list of documents has to be kept. Letter case counts, so Windows and Linux see the same documents (CF-S7). A folder that matches but isn't a valid document, such as a code folder build/build.xml, is listed with a load error, so a manifest damaged that way can't vanish: Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S12; review Q14 rejected).
object.description: Mellon shall treat as a document each folder directly under the repository root that holds a file named <folder name>.xml, letter case included, unless the folder's name starts with a dot.
